title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Two-map Spaces direction with fixed frontal view

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v12 broadens Map 2 pillar distribution across the full lateral hall, strengthens monotonic world-Z darkening for farther cylinders, and adds wheel + WASD movement while keeping the view direction fixed.

open_feedback: Review Map 2 on wide desktop and portrait: architecture should occupy left/center/right rather than collapse into a central strip.
Review far-cylinder darkening: equivalent farther columns should read clearly darker than nearer ones.
Review controls: wheel up/down moves forward/back; W/S forward/back; A/D lateral strafe; camera orientation remains fixed.
